readings.text: Full-data refitting reproduces the occupation-side margin while smaller fits lose it: the previous reduced-training experiment did not settle full-data feasibility.
An ordinary equally exposed control explains the gain: same training-size gain on ['brier', 'men_brier', 'nll']; control also meets the occupation-side reserve at sizes ['100'].

interpretation.scope: Do not claim a population learning curve, independent replication or proof that size caused every historical difference.
